en.explanation:
UAB = 40 J as process is isochoric.

UBC = + 50 (WBC = 50 J)

UC = UA + UAB + UBC = 1650

For CA process,

QCA = 60 J

UCA + WCA = 60

90 + WCA = 60

WCA = +30 J

The graph given is inconsistent with the statement BC may be adiabatic and CA cannot be like isobaric as shown, as increasing volume while rejecting heat at same time.
